name: OSHKOSH DEFENSE LLC
brief_text:
Four detectors flagged Oshkosh Defense. Benford's law analysis found the leading-digit distribution of award amounts significantly deviates from expected patterns, with digit 2 and 3 appearing far more frequently than natural. Modification growth on contract SPE7LX24D0096 expanded at 777.7 times its initial value, vastly outpacing the 24-fold median growth rate for motor vehicle manufacturers. The entity also concentrates heavily on sole-source awards at 45 percent, compared to zero median for peers in its NAICS code. Multivariate isolation analysis flagged it as a statistical outlier given its extreme scale, single-agency focus, and modification intensity.

The Benford test yielded a KS statistic of 0.128 with p-value 3.2e-22 across 1,540 transactions. The modification growth z-score reached 7.24 sigmas. Sole-source concentration z-score was 4.02 sigmas, with 695 of 1,540 awards sole-sourced versus a peer median of zero. The isolation anomaly score was 0.985 on a 0-to-1 scale. Lifetime obligated value totals 10.75 billion dollars.

These statistical signals warrant scrutiny but do not prove misconduct. Oshkosh Defense is a major defense contractor with legitimate reasons for high modification frequency and sole-source awards in specialized vehicle manufacturing. The single-agency concentration reflects its primary DoD customer base. Benford deviations can arise from contract-bundling practices or tiered pricing structures common in large defense programs. The peer group for sole-source comparison is small (33 entities), limiting statistical power.
